name: Avalokitesvara Festival, Marble Mountains
nameVi: Lễ hội Quan Thế Âm Ngũ Hành Sơn
summary: A Buddhist festival at Quan The Am and the Marble Mountains, on the 17th, 18th, and 19th days of the second lunar month. The city portal dates the modern annual form to 1991. The civil date moves, so check it on arrival. The hill’s usual tickets still apply unless a notice says otherwise.
when: The 17th to the 19th day of the second lunar month. The civil date is check on arrival.
